description: FP4-Local checkpoint served by the exact eugr b12x ARM64 image pinned in vcruz305’s kit at 0d727c4e. Eight concurrent sequences, a 262,144-token window, FP8 KV and four-token MTP speculation. Preserves the kit’s b12x load format, disk-backed PLE table and one-worker compilation setting. The 110 GB peak is a conservative runtime estimate for the 0.8 GPU-memory utilization setting and host workspace; physical Spark execution is unmeasured here.
title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next FP4-Local vLLM single Spark (vcruz305)
